abstract: A clinical statistical analysis on 65 patients with 68 testicular germ cell tumors was performed. Thirty-six testes (53.7%) had seminomas and the remainder non-seminomatous germ cell testicular tumors (NSGCTTs). Of the seminomas, 31 (88.6%) were in stage I and the others showed distant metastases at presentation. Of the 32 NSGCTTs, 22 (68.8%) were in stage I. The average ages of the patients with seminomas and NSGCTTs were 40.4 and 29.9 years, respectively. Thirty-nine patients (60.0%) had tumors on the right side, 23 (35.4%) on the left and 3 (4.6%) in both testes. Five patients had a past history of cryptorchidism. Chief complaints in 49 patients (73.1%) were a painless scrotal mass. The interval from clinical onset to presentation was longer in seminoma patients than in NSGCTT patients (10.9 months on average versus 3.4 months). Immunosuppressive acidic protein (IAP) was a useful diagnostic tumor marker as well as alpha-feto protein (AFP), beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (beta-hCG) and lactic dehydrogenase (LDH). We adopted a surveillance policy in more than half of the stage I patients and obtained acceptable results. In the remaining cases, therapies including combination chemotherapy, radiation and salvage operation were performed after orchiectomy. The three-year survival rate was 98.0, 100.0 and 26.7%, for stage I, II and III patients respectively.
abstract_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍65例68病変について臨床統計解析を行った。36病変(53.7%)がセミノーマで、残りは非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCTT)であった。セミノーマのうち31例(88.6%)は病期Iで、他は初診時に遠隔転移を有していた。NSGCTT32例のうち22例(68.8%)は病期Iであった。セミノーマ患者とNSGCTT患者の平均年齢はそれぞれ40.4歳、29.9歳であった。39例(60.0%)は右側、23例(35.4%)は左側、3例(4.6%)は両側に腫瘍を有していた。5例に停留精巣の既往があった。49例(73.1%)の主訴は無痛性陰嚢腫瘤であった。臨床発症から受診までの期間は、セミノーマ患者の方がNSGCTT患者より長かった(平均10.9か月対3.4か月)。免疫抑制酸性蛋白(IAP)は、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、β-hCG、乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)と同様、有用な腫瘍マーカーであった。病期Iの患者の半数以上で監視療法を採用し、良好な結果を得た。残りの症例では、精巣摘除術後に併用化学療法、放射線療法、救済手術などの治療を行った。3年生存率は病期I、II、IIIの患者でそれぞれ98.0%、100.0%、26.7%であった。
